description: Defines the PersistentStateAttribute class, which is an attribute used to specify options for persistent state in Orleans. The class includes properties for state name and storage provider, and implements related interfaces.

classes.name: PersistentStateAttribute
classes.description: An attribute class used to specify options for persistent state in Orleans. It includes properties for state name and storage provider, and implements IFacetMetadata and IPersistentStateConfiguration interfaces.

methods.name: PersistentStateAttribute
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new instance of the PersistentStateAttribute class with specified state name and optional storage name.
